title: The orientation sheaf map
statement: Let $o_Y:(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_Y\to\mathcal H^2(Rs^!_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}L_1)$ be the composite of $\kappa^{\Proet}_Y$ of Definition [pur9-def-kummer-generator-proet] with $\mathcal H^1(\delta)$, $\delta$ the connecting map of Lemma “The zero-section triangle” (`pur9-lem-orientation-triangle`, in [sk-prop-a1]), using $j^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}L_1=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_{\mathbf G_{m,Y}}(1)$.
